name: tabular_kaggle_clean
title: A Kaggle-shaped tabular pipeline written correctly: ColumnTransformer + Pipeline + StratifiedKFold + LightGBM early stopping on the inner fold
origin: hardening round 1, tester domain-tabular: the correct half of the Kaggle-style pair

forbidden.why: no transformer is fitted anywhere outside the Pipeline; the only fit calls in this project are Pipeline.fit at lines 57 and 70, both on training rows
pipeline.py declares the imputer, scaler and encoder as Pipeline steps and never calls fit on any of them
the held-out rows reach exactly one call, predict_proba at line 75; nothing is ever fitted on test_x or on a validation fold
the estimator handed to the fold loop is build_model(...), a Pipeline whose first step is the preprocessor - which is the fix MLV103 asks for
there is no timestamp anywhere in this project: no parse_dates, no to_datetime, no sort by a date column
seed_everything() seeds random and numpy at lines 30-31, and every estimator and splitter carries random_state=SEED
train_test_split at line 41 and StratifiedKFold at line 46 both pass random_state=SEED
the only metrics here are roc_auc_score and average_precision_score, both in the score-metric carve-out, and both are fed predict_proba columns
roc_auc_score is given model.predict_proba(...)[:, 1] at lines 61 and 75, a score column rather than a hard label
there is no torch in this project and no hand-written gradient step
model.eval() is a torch idiom with no LightGBM or sklearn equivalent
torch.no_grad() has no meaning in a LightGBM program
no device is ever named in this project

notes: MLV117 (train_test_split without stratify=) is catalogued but not implemented, so it cannot carry a forbidden label; for the record, in train.py: the split passes stratify=labels
